planets.name: TOI-733 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-733 with a 4.88-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-733 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-733. Its orbit and size follow Georgieva et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
